Classify a sheet/data.frame's role in an omics import

Source: R/io-classify.R
classify_sheet_role.Rd

Walks a small decision tree to label one sheet as "matrix", "metadata", "feature_annot", or "unknown". Returns the confidence in [0, 1] so callers can present alternatives.

Usage

classify_sheet_role(df, name = NA_character_)

Arguments

df

A data.frame.

name

Optional sheet name (used as a tiebreaker hint).

Value

A list with role, confidence, orientation, notes.

See also
